# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Before proposing or generating code for this repository, read and follow **/FOUNDATION.md**.

That file is the canonical S.KOSIF product charter and has priority over conflicting legacy interpretations.

Non-negotiables:
- One unified platform: accounting, audit, reporting, financial analysis, standards, AI, documents, and helper tools.
- Preserve useful prior capabilities; legacy UI/implementation may be replaced.
- Do not reduce the product to a dashboard/chatbot or a single accounting/audit module.
- Enforce company/workspace isolation and protected «تصيف» data.
- Use deterministic/verifiable financial logic before AI interpretation.
- If the product foundation is explicitly changed, update `FOUNDATION.md` first in the same change.
